post.text: Immediately after Russians hastily posted photos of the "Ukrainian drone that attacked Putin’s residence” this morning, open source investigators already noted that the drone appears to be a black-painted Russian Gerbera, also featuring a battery and cellular modem module from a https://t.co/qKRs0v69cs

description.description: The image is a compilation of several photos showing the wreckage of drones, along with diagrams and electronic components. The upper photos show a black, crashed drone in the snow, revealing its internal engine and wiring. The middle photos show a white fixed-wing drone and a close-up of a motor with a wooden propeller. Technical components like a Savox servo and a SIM800C module are also featured. An infographic at the bottom right identifies a 'RUSSIAN DRONE ORLAN-10' and lists various foreign-sourced components including Swiss GPS, Japanese engines, and Chinese electronics.
description.ocrText: ONLINE.UA The element base for electronic circuits is produced in Malaysia, Korea, Japan, and China. Servo drives manufactured by Savox (Sweden-China). Scorpion engines (USA-China). Radio channels (except Russian and their own) are produced by RFDesign (Australia). Engine regulators (except for Russian and our own) are manufactured by Scorpion (USA-China) and Hobbyking (China).
